# Release v3.6.0

<!-- Generated by cidx on 2026-09-29 17:22 -->
<!-- Edit this file to customize your release notes -->

## ✨ Features

- **generate:** declare a phase's evidence upload so regeneration keeps it (#512)

  A phase can declare what it uploads after it runs, including when it fails:

  ```toml
  [cluster]
  containers = ["cluster-build", "cluster-probatum"]
  artifacts = { name = "cluster-evidence", paths = [".probatum/runs/*/"], retention_days = 7 }
  ```

  The generated job gets an `actions/upload-artifact` step after the phase with
  `if: always()`, hidden files included, and a warning rather than an error when
  a path holds nothing. Such a step used to be addable only by hand, and
  `cidx generate` removed it (#509). The name may not be `cidx-binary`, two
  phases cannot share a name, and paths must stay inside the workspace;
  `cidx validate` and `cidx generate` both refuse a declaration that breaks
  these.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **release:** tag only once the merged commit is what HEAD points at (#511)

  When the post-merge pull failed, `cidx release create` tagged whatever `HEAD`
  was — the commit before the bump — instead of the merged release commit. It
  now checks, without the network, that `HEAD` is on the base branch, has moved
  and descends from where the release started, and otherwise tags nothing and
  says how to finish (#510).
